description: Use when asked about a receptor, channel or enzyme. One receptor, ion channel or enzyme by name or gene (for example CB1, CNR1, TRPV1, GPR55, FAAH, CYP3A4): what it is, where it sits in the body, the compounds mapped to it with their action, effect and evidence grade, and every measured binding or functional value with species and PubMed identifiers, plus the measured 3D structure (the PDB entry, method, resolution, organism, paper, licence, a viewer link and a still picture) or "No measured structure yet". Educational reference, not medical advice. Example arguments: {"id":"CB1"}.
name: get_target
title: Get a molecular target
